subject: planner: Simplify plan cache code.gi (#61906)
summary: Reviewed this commit’s planner/executor changes relative to its first parent. Main behavioral change is splitting optimization into `Optimize` + `optimizeNoCache`, introducing `core.OptimizeAstNodeNoCache`, and making plan-cache rebuilds call the no-cache optimizer to avoid plan-cache recursion/double-running hint side effects; non-prepared plan cache is consulted earlier (so point-get queries can now hit it). No remaining Blocker/High issues found in correctness/SQL semantics, privilege, transaction/session behavior, or concurrency for the touched planner/executor paths; later upstream history does not show a follow-up fix suggesting a bug in this change.
